text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-I've heard so much about you!
Being invited to do flower arrangement... it's an honor!

text_block_list.name: Ikebana Master
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is mine.
I'm quite the enthusiast when it comes to both your races...
Let us enjoy arranging flowers together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Expressing my love through flowers.
I, too, am looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(W-Will I be okay...? I never imagined
I'd be invited alongside Ramonu-san...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(N-No, no! I can't let myself get intimidated,
I've gotta relax and enjoy this!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, such pretty flowers!
We pick from among these and arrange them, right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then, I'll go with this refreshing flower, and...
if there are marguerites, I'd like to add just those.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... the flower Ramonu-san is about to pick
is wilting. Maybe I should tell her—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(! N-No, wait.
What if I give her poor advice...?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
I simply do not understand this "love for life."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Still a long way to go, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(To someone as flawless as Ramonu-san,
I might just be getting in the way...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. This wilting blossom here...
Could you treat the stem to help it drink?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (...I was overthinking it completelyyyy!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That flower arrangement is so classy and gorgeous!
All that's left is to place this rose—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Wait, it still has thorns! What if she hurts
herself...?! No, but—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes, I am aware.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Do you take me for an infant?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(A-As I thought, it'd totally be
overstepping my bounds...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
My, a thorn.
May I borrow some shears?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (S-She handled it completely normallyyyy!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... I couldn't do a single thing, could I?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(There were so many things I noticed, yet...
I just stood there and watched.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to... escort Ramonu-san properly—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Wait, whoaaa?! R-R-Ramonu-san?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: How timid.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Afraid of being rejected, yet wishing to reach out nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: So delicate—how endearing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: !!? E-Endearing...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: (Hawawa...! She totally thinks I'm just a helpless fledgling of a horse girl~...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I spotted a horse girl sighing to herself as she worked out.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... What can I do so I can stand tall and proud right next to her...?
